title: Amazon robots vs Amazon employees

source.name: Amazon Robotics one-millionth-robot announcement (2025); Amazon global workforce size, as reported by trade press
source.note: Employee figure is Amazon's total global workforce (all roles, not warehouse-only); it is the closest publicly reported headcount to compare against the robot fleet.

notes: Amazon's robot fleet passed 1 million machines in 2025. Amazon's global headcount peaked near 1.6 million employees in 2021 and was reported around 1.5 million more recently -- so the robot fleet is now roughly two-thirds the size of the entire human workforce.
